checkpointExtra: Also update the project files/notes you normally maintain (e.g. a daily .md, README, task log, or a commit) so the work is saved the way you work.
resumePrompt: Auto-resume by Session Guardian. Read SESSION-STATE.md in this directory, do the next 1-2 planned steps from its 'Next steps' section, update the checkpoint, then stop. Do not start unrelated work.

_docs.sensor: Primary source is Claude Code's OWN rate-limit numbers, delivered to the status line on stdin (rate_limits.five_hour / seven_day) — the same figures behind the native usage popups. The status line caches them for the brake hooks. ccusage is only a fallback for headless auto-resume runs, where there is no status line.
_docs.thresholdPct: Fire the brake (checkpoint + auto-resume arm) when the 5-hour used_percentage crosses this.
_docs.brakeOnEstimate: false (default) = the brake/toasts/banner ONLY fire on Claude Code's official rate-limit numbers (available when a terminal status line is running). Set true to also fire on the ccusage time-based estimate — NOT recommended: that estimate reflects elapsed time in the window, not real usage, and causes false alarms in the VS Code extension.
_docs.milestonePcts: Extra ambient heads-up TOASTS at these levels (once per window each), so VS Code users — who have no status line — still get visible usage warnings. Keep these different from thresholdPct to avoid a double toast at the brake.
_docs.chatBannerPct: When 5-hour usage is at/above this (but below the brake), a UserPromptSubmit hook asks Claude to start each reply with a one-line usage banner IN THE CHAT. Set 0 for an always-on banner, or 101 to disable.
_docs.checkpointExtra: Extra instruction appended to the brake's checkpoint step — tell Claude to also update whatever local files/.md/notes you personally keep, so the checkpoint matches your workflow.
_docs.autonomous: true = auto-resume the session at reset. false = only checkpoint (no scheduled resume).
_docs.maxAutoCycles: Hard cap on consecutive autonomous resumes before Guardian stops re-arming.
_docs.projectAllowlist: Empty = resume allowed from any project dir. Add absolute cwd paths to restrict autonomous resume to those projects only.
_docs.killSwitchFile: If a file with this name exists in the project dir OR the Guardian data dir, no arm and no resume happen.
_docs.greeting: true = on the next INTERACTIVE session after Guardian auto-resumed while you were away, a SessionStart hook has Claude open its first reply with a 'while you were away' summary (once). Factual counts come from the real event log, not Claude's narrative.
_docs.notifyTopic: Optional phone push, no account/server/n8n needed: set any unique string (e.g. 'guardian-kostas-7f3a'), install the free ntfy app, and subscribe to that topic. Guardian POSTs a one-line summary to ntfy.sh/<topic> when a resume completes. Empty = off. Self-host: also set notifyUrl.
_docs.notifyUrl: Base URL for push. Default https://ntfy.sh (public). Point to your own ntfy server (e.g. on the Hetzner box) for privacy.
_docs.manageStatusLine: true = auto-add a live '⏳ 62% · reset 15:00' status line to ~/.claude/settings.json on session start (self-healing, never overrides a status line you set yourself). Set false to manage it manually.
_docs.statusRefreshSeconds: refreshInterval for the status line — re-runs it on a timer so usage stays current even while idle.
_docs.senseCacheSeconds: Freshness window for the cached usage the brake hooks read; older than this triggers a hidden ccusage fallback refresh (headless only).
_docs.resumeBufferMinutes: Schedule the resume this many minutes AFTER the reset time.
